## Defects the sweep found — fixed here

- **SIG-UI-DV08 print gap** — `planPrintPages` only emitted figure pages for
  record-declared `print_figures`, unpopulated on jurisdiction dossiers:
  drawn fig-maps printed nowhere. `web/src/lib/print.ts` gained
  `derivedFigures` (record-declared kinds never shadowed); `print.astro`
  derives the drawn-map declaration from the visuals doc. All 10 drawn-map
  print routes now print the map on page 2; `usa/vi`'s typed absence
  correctly prints none.
- **SIG-UI-D20 curate leak** — the internal contradictions page rendered
  `claim.evidence_ref` bare; now `<code class="sig-mut">`.
